name: Honor 30

images.credit: Ahmadkurdi44, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Weight: Honor 30: 185 g, Honor 30 Pro: 186 g, Honor 30 Pro+: 190 g
Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (built-in under the display), proximity sensor, light sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass

Platform.Operating system: Magic UI 3.1.1 based on Android 10 (system version)
Platform.Chipset: Honor 30: Kirin 985, Honor 30 Pro/Honor 30 Pro+: Kirin 990 5G
Platform.GPU: Honor 30: Mali-G77MP8, Honor 30 Pro/Honor 30 Pro+: Mali-G76MP16

Memory.RAM: 30: 6/8 GB, 30 Pro: 8 GB, 30 Pro+: 8/12 GB, LPDDR4X
Memory.Storage: Honor 30/Honor 30 Pro: 128/256 GB, Honor 30 Pro+: 256 GB, UFS 3.0

Display.Display: Honor 30: 6.53 inches, 2400x1080 FHD+, OLED, Honor 30 Pro/Honor 30 Pro+: 6.57 inches, 2340x1080 90Hz OLED

Cameras.Front camera: Honor 30: 32-megapixel camera (f/2.0), Honor 30 Pro/Honor 30 Pro+: 32-megapixel camera (f/2.0) + 8 million Pixel camera (f/2.2)

Battery.Battery: All models: non-removable, Li-Po 4000 mAh, 30 & 30 Pro: 40W fast charging, fast wireless 27W charging, 5W reverse charging, 30 Pro+: 40W fast charging, 25W fast wireless charging, 5W reverse charging
